I did not receive the FISP coupon this year, so I cannot afford the chemical fertilizer from the shop. I have kept some local maize seed from last season's harvest to plant on this small plot. With my children helping, we can manage the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves without hiring ganyu workers. We depend on the rains, as we have no way to irrigate this land.
